_note: Scrape config. Set 'format' to the MTG format you want to track (Standard, Modern, Pioneer, Legacy, etc.). Both mtg_fetch.py and fetch_mtgo.py read this file. Override per-run with --format on either script. For non-Standard formats, 'weeks_window' controls how far back the melee search goes (Standard uses set_releases.json for the set-rotation anchor instead).
